full_judgment: 51. Another seizure-list witness was not examined by the prosecution who is none but the mother of the deceased Kabita who is charge-sheet witness No.31. In the seizure-list, it has been written by the Investigating Officer that the earring was seized by identification of the witness No.31. Now the question is why prosecution withheld this vital and important witness. According to section 114(g) of the Evidence Act, the presumption would be that if she had come, surely would not have supported the prosecution version and, as such, she was withheld.
